item.title: Socratic Seminar #15
item.author: Unknown
item.description:
Location

Block B, AUJ Complex, CBD Abuja

Map

Agenda

Announcements

We are excited to introduce our fifteenth Socratic Seminar! A special thank you to our sponsor BTrust for food, refreshments, and Bitnob for hosting the meetup.

Reminders

  • We prefer no photos and no videos during the event
  • Chatham House Rule
  • Leave the meeting space as clean as you found it
  • Suggest topics for the next Socratic Seminar! by creating an issue on our repo BitDevs Repo
  • Where to find topics?

In Bitcoin

MC: Tuedon

Decoding Bitcoin Transactions

Brief

  • Understand the structure of a raw Bitcoin transaction
  • Decode a raw Bitcoin transaction manually and with available tools
  • Identify and explain the purpose of each transaction field
  • Understand transaction inputs, outputs, scripts, witness data, locktime, and version fields
  • Read transaction data directly from a block explorer or node RPC output

Bonus

  • Create and broadcast a Bitcoin transaction during the session
  • Decode the transaction live and inspect every field together

In Lightning

MC: Eni

  • Lightning Protocol Specification

Refreshment Break, Chill and Chat

Book Club Review

MC: Eni

  • Book Club Monthly Review

Where to Learn

  • Learn Me a Bitcoin - Transactions

    • Detailed breakdown of every transaction component

  • Mastering Bitcoin (Open Edition)

    • Chapters covering transaction construction, scripts, and serialization

  • Bitcoin Developer Documentation

    • Reference guide to transaction fields and formats

  • Mempool.space

    • Explore and inspect real Bitcoin transactions

  • But how does bitcoin actually work? (3Blue1Brown)

    • Visual explanation of cryptographic primitives, hashing, and proof-of-work

News

item.description:

In Bitcoin

MC: Tuedon

  • Bitcoin Core development and transaction relay policy
  • policy: uncap datacarrier by default #32406 merged into Bitcoin Core
    • Glozow explanation of the merge
  • Censorship Resistant Transaction Relay - Taking out the garbage(man)
  • The case for privatizing Bitcoin Core
  • Seedless is safer
  • BitScript

Refreshment Break, Chill and Chat

Other Bitcoin Tech

MC: Shytypes

  • NIP-47: Protocol for connecting Nostr clients to remote Lightning wallets.
  • Enables secure wallet access via end-to-end encrypted Nostr DMs.
  • Roles:
    • Client: requests wallet actions.
    • Wallet Service: API server.
    • User: links wallet.
  • Event Kinds:
    • 13194: Info
    • 23194: Request
    • 23195: Response
    • 23196: Notification
  • Connection: via URI (includes wallet pubkey, relay, secret).
  • Commands: pay_invoice, make_invoice, get_balance, etc.
  • Notifications: payment_received, payment_sent.
  • Security: one-time keys per session, improves privacy.
  • Use Cases: works for custodial/non-custodial wallets on any platform.
